alerts.title: Hypothyroidism Management
alerts.message: Guidelines do not specify levothyroxine dose adjustment based on TSH levels. Patient's TSH is 12.4 mIU/L, indicating potential under-treatment. However, non-adherence to thyroid medication may also contribute to elevated TSH.

evidence.recommended_action: Assess adherence to levothyroxine and consider dose adjustment.

alerts.title: Weight Gain on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines suggest DTG may not be directly associated with weight gain. Patient has experienced significant weight gain on TLD. Other factors such as diet, exercise, or other medications may contribute to weight gain.

evidence.recommended_action: Consider lifestyle factors and monitor weight.
